Thanks — quick sizing + notes based on the 12k QPS profile and a 60/40 read/gen mix. These are preliminary and assume use of our optimized quantized LLM variant (q8_compat) for cost efficiency.

Preliminary Dedicated sizing (ballpark):
- Small baseline: 4x A10G equivalent GPUs (good for conv load, ~3–5k sustained QPS)
- Mid baseline: 8x A10G equivalent GPUs (target for ~8–14k burst QPS with batching + KV cache enabled)
- Aggressive: 16x A100s (for headroom, very low P99 latencies under heavy multimodal prompts)

Cost notes (estimate range for a 3-hour reserved window including prep & replay):
- 4x A10G: ~$3,500–$5,000
- 8x A10G: ~$6,500–$9,000
- 16x A100: ~$18,000–$25,000

Operational caveats / dependencies:
1) Tokenization drift: if Acme's tokenizer differs (custom pre-tokenization), expect ~10–20% variance in token counts; bring a sample to validate.
2) Payload size distribution: if your generate responses are large (>512 tokens), we need to account for memory/KV cache sizing.
3) PII scrubbing: must be completed prior to handing data to our replay infra; we can accept redacted S3 tarball or Drive upload.
4) Network egress: if replay runs from Redwood-hosted infra into Acme endpoints, network configs must be validated (we prefer isolated staging endpoints).

- Acme owner: jordan.price — share redacted S3 link or Drive upload by 2026-04-05 EOD (Jordan already indicated same-day).
